description:
🌑🌙 Azure UmbraSomnia

Azure UmbraSomnia is a versatile base model created from a merge of several Illustrious checkpoints that consistently produce high-quality results.
The model is designed to be highly flexible, capable of generating outputs ranging from anime to semi-realistic rendering.

UmbraSomnia focuses on balancing style variety, clarity, and LoRA compatibility, making it suitable as a general-purpose base for many types of prompts.

Base Merge Composition

Part 1

  • Furry Dreams – Illustrious v1.0 → 0.3

  • Azure & Crimson Mix – V3.0 B Fix → 0.7

Part 2

  • Banana Splitz XL – Vee 7 Point Oh! (Side A) → 0.4

  • Shadow Shift – Phantom v2
